# CreateAndColor

> CreateAndColor is a free AI coloring page generator for kids. A child (or parent) types, says, or spins for any idea — "a robot dinosaur on a skateboard" — and the app instantly draws a printable black-and-white coloring page. It is available as a free iOS app and a free web app. Made for ages 2–10 and loved by parents, teachers, and homeschoolers.

## What it does

- Turns any idea into a printable coloring page in seconds using AI image generation.
- Three ways to create: type it, say it (voice input, so pre-readers can use it alone), or spin a "slot machine" for a surprise idea.
- Magic Lens: turn a photo of a real toy, pet, or moment into a coloring page.
- Party Pack: generate 20 custom themed coloring pages at once for birthday parties and classrooms.
- Save pages to a gallery, print as PDF, and share.
- Safe and kid-friendly with content moderation; ad-free creating.

## Who it's for

- Parents looking for an easy, screen-free activity for quiet time, rainy days, road trips, and restaurants.
- Teachers and homeschoolers who want custom coloring pages tied to a lesson or a child's interests (a dedicated teacher mode with credits is available).
- Kids ages 2–10 who want to color something that doesn't exist anywhere else.

## Pricing and platforms

- Free to create and print coloring pages.
- Free iOS app: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760249757
- Free web app: https://createandcolor.aivantageworks.com

## Why it's different

Unlike static printable libraries, CreateAndColor is not a fixed set of pages — it generates a brand-new, unique coloring page for literally any idea a child can describe, so they never color the same page twice.
